1: Ahoy! Ready for a pirate adventure? Sail the seas and hunt for treasure!
Use your map to explore, solve puzzles, and watch out for danger!

Survive, find allies, and claim your loot!
5: Ahoy, mate! Your journey starts on a mysterious island.
